ratings_why.fun: Saving for three turns and then blowing 30 gold in one loud summer turn is a moment players will chase; the early Hive is quiet, which keeps it off 8.
ratings_why.distinct: Paying for gold flow both ways (Thrift and Spree) plays unlike any of today's tribes, though Spree alone echoes familiar spend-gold triggers.

verdict_why: v2 fixed the reading gaps (town tags, Ottavia's freeze, Clemenza's order, Mask scope); further rounds would mostly make it different, not clearer.

points.text: Put by is the one hard word: income and sold units count, spending savings wipes it. The live shop counter the risks list proposes should be part of the design, not a maybe.
Maestro Tettix growing in hand is the best read in the tribe: the nymph waiting in the Long Dark is something you actually do. More hand-as-underground cards could carry it.
The worker's barbed sting is missing, and the Hive has no early fighter. A Guard Bee that dies when it hits but deals a lot would show the fable's cost of thrift on the board.
Mother Melissa reads as 'lays every citizen and decides nothing' well; letting her copy pick the Hive unit with the most copies would tie the laying to triples at a glance.
Busker's two halves (Sprees for Attack, put by for Health) make a Tier 1 that teaches both keywords in one card; worth keeping as the tribe's tutorial unit.

standouts.why: Grows in hand while you save, then leads the band on the summer turn: the cicada's seven years in one card.
Lord Fennimore thrown out and back in the shop bigger, every time, is the fable's joke as a Spree pump.
Comptroller Gravelle spraying bad accounts with the bank's size reads instantly and makes saving visible in the fight.

weakest.why: Wax-Seal Banker is plain interest with little woodland in it.
Nurse Bee is a generic positional buffer; nursing doesn't show in what it does.
Olive-Press Hand's crossed buffs are right in idea but read as a swap puzzle, and it's easy to mix up which town gets which.

flags.note: With Madame Cigale each Fennimore cycle (2 net gold) is a Spree plus +2/+2 to him; the loop ends with gold, but it's worth the owner's eye.
Several Tettix Masks plus Penniless Tenor grow steeply, as the risks list says.
Mother Melissa under Old Messor and Clemenza lays many copies a turn toward triples.
